short: LM candidates scored by encoding-model likelihood (M06) were ahead in 2022, as the authors claim; the scorer is now overtaken. GPT prior (M07) is standard; one pilot-touched test story limits M12.
position: The paper [@tang2023] changed the decoding search (M06), the use-time prior (M07) and the use-time action (M04). M06 is ahead only in the authors' stated sense: language-model candidates searched by beam and scored by encoding-model likelihood, absent from earlier non-invasive language studies in the ledger (Appendix), with above-null decoding in all three subjects and an fMRI ablation (Extended Data Fig. 9); encoding-model scoring itself is older [@wehbe2014], and MapGuide [@zhao2024] later kept the search and replaced the scorer. M07 and M04 are standard [@affolter2020; @martin2014]. The language-model null suits a generative decoder, but all perceived-speech numbers come from one test story used in S3 pilots. The privacy claim holds under later functional alignment [@tang2025], with consent as the open issue.
